description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for configuring URL-based language negotiation, allowing administrators to set path prefixes or domain names for different languages.

classes.name: NegotiationUrlForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring URL-based language negotiation settings, including path prefixes and domain names.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with configuration and language manager dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns the configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form elements for URL language negotiation configuration.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form input, ensuring uniqueness and correctness of prefixes and domains.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Saves the configuration settings based on form input.
